senses.gloss: (b. h.; Shaf. of קף, cmp. כפף)to bend, arch.—Denom. שְׁקוֹף, מַשְׁקוֹף.
[to be bent towards,] to look out; to face, be seen. Y. M. Kat. III, beg. 81ᶜ (in a riddle) משמים נִשְׁקָפָה she (the soul?) looks down from heaven.
units: <cite ref="Bamidbar Rabbah 19">Num. R. s. 19<sup>26</sup></cite> (ref. to <cite ref="Numbers 21:20">Num. XXI, 20</cite>) <he>העומד … והוא הבאר הנִשְׁקָף וכ׳</he> he that stands on the face (plateau) of Jeshimon sees something in the sea (of Tiberias) …, and this is the well (of Miriam) which is seen from Jeshimon; (v.
<cite ref="Vayikra Rabbah 22">Lev. R. s. 22</cite>; <cite ref="Kohelet Rabbah 5:8">Koh. R. to V, 8</cite>; Y. Kil. IX, 32ᶜ bot.).
<cite ref="Berakhot 29a:1">Ber. 29ᵃ</cite> top <he>ה׳ בה שתים וכ׳</he> he thought over it (trying to recall it) two or three minutes.

senses.gloss: (denom. of שְׁקוֹף) to arch, curve, diminish the width of.
units: <cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 31:11">Gen. R. s. 31</cite> <he>והיה מַשְׁקִיף בה ועולה וכ׳</he> and he curved it (the wall of the ark) as he went up &c., v. <cite ref="S01498"><he>קַמְרוֹטוֹן</he></cite>; <cite ref="Yalkut Shimoni on Torah 54">Yalk. ib. 54</cite>.
